cards.claim: Doug Harvey (ice hockey) was a Canadian professional hockey player who played in the National Hockey League (NHL).
cards.quote: Doug Harvey (ice hockey) Douglas Norman Harvey (December 19, 1924 – December 26, 1989) was a Canadian professional hockey player who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) from 1947 until 1964, and from 1966 until 1969.

cards.claim: In 1999, the Society for American Baseball Research ranked Harvey as the second-greatest umpire in history, behind only Bill Klem.
